verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना ।सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे ।। ५.६७.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu hanumān rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।sītāyā bhāṣitaṁ sarvaṁ nyavedayata rāghave ।। 5.67.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus asked by Sri Rama, Hanuman repeated everything spoken by Sita to Rama.

verses.sloka: इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ ।पूर्ववृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथातथम् ।। ५.६७.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: idamuktavatī devī jānakī puruṣarṣabha ।pūrvavṛttamabhijñānaṁ citrakūṭe yathātatham ।। 5.67.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "O bull among men queen Janaki related to me as a token of identification an incident that had taken place at Chitrakuta in the past.

verses.sloka: सुखसुप्ता त्वया सार्धं जानकी पूर्वमुत्थिता ।वायसः सहसोत्पत्य विरराद स्तनान्तरे ।। ५.६७.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sukhasuptā tvayā sārdhaṁ jānakī pūrvamutthitā ।vāyasaḥ sahasotpatya virarāda stanāntare ।। 5.67.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "When she was lying on your lap happily she awoke early and a crow came swiftly and scratched on her breast.

verses.sloka: पर्यायेण च सुप्तस्त्वं देव्यङ्के भरताग्रज ।पुनश्च किल पक्षी स देव्या जनयति व्यथाम् ।। ५.६७.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: paryāyeṇa ca suptastvaṁ devyaṅke bharatāgraja ।punaśca kila pakṣī sa devyā janayati vyathām ।। 5.67.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Bharata's brother, when Sita awoke from sleep you slept on her lap. The same crow again hurt her.

verses.sloka: पुनः पुनरुपागम्य विरराद भृशं किल ।ततस्त्वं बोधितस्तस्याः शोणितेन समुक्षितः ।। ५.६७.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: punaḥ punarupāgamya virarāda bhṛśaṁ kila ।tatastvaṁ bodhitastasyāḥ śoṇitena samukṣitaḥ ।। 5.67.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Again and again the crow came to her and scratched her. She woke you up as you were getting wet with blood shed from her body.

verses.sloka: वायसेन च तेनैव सततं बाध्यमानया ।बोधितः किल देव्या त्वं सुखसुप्तः परन्तप ।। ५.६७.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vāyasena ca tenaiva satataṁ bādhyamānayā ।bodhitaḥ kila devyā tvaṁ sukhasuptaḥ parantapa ।। 5.67.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "O scorcher of enemies pained by the crow hurting her repeatedly, while you were sleeping happily, she woke you up and informed you about it.

verses.sloka: तां तु दृष्ट्वा महाबाहो दारितां च स्तनान्तरे ।आशीविष इव क्रुद्धो निःश्वसन्नभ्यभाषथाः ।। ५.६७.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā mahābāho dāritāṁ ca stanāntare ।āśīviṣa iva kruddho niḥśvasannabhyabhāṣathāḥ ।। 5.67.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing the blood flowing from her breasts you became furious like a hissing serpent and said:

verses.sloka: नखाग्रैः केन ते भीरु दारितं तु स्तनान्तरम् ।कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ।। ५.६७.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nakhāgraiḥ kena te bhīru dāritaṁ tu stanāntaram ।kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā ।। 5.67.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are of timid nature. Who has scratched your breasts with the tip of the nail? Who is sporting with an enraged fivehooded serpent"?

verses.sloka: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा वायसं समवैक्षथाः ।नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ।। ५.६७.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā vāyasaṁ samavaikṣathāḥ ।nakhaiḥ sarudhiraistīkṣṇaistāmevābhimukhaṁ sthitam ।। 5.67.9 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Seeing all over, at once I glanced at the crow that stood in front of her with sharp bloodstained nails'.

verses.sloka: सुतः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः ।धरान्तरचरः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः ।। ५.६७.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sutaḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṁ varaḥ ।dharāntaracaraḥ śīghraṁ pavanasya gatau samaḥ ।। 5.67.10 ।।।।

translations.english: 'That crow, the foremost of the birds was the son of Indra moving about all over the earth swiftly. His speed matched the Windgod's.

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहो कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः ।वायसे त्वं कृथाः क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वर ।। ५.६७.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastasmin mahābāho kopasaṁvartitekṣaṇaḥ ।vāyase tvaṁ kṛthāḥ krūrāṁ matiṁ matimatāṁ vara ।। 5.67.11 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O longarmed, wise and revered Rama, then in anguish you took a cruel decision'.

verses.sloka: स दर्भं संस्तराद् गृह्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण ह्ययोजयः ।स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखः खगम् ।। ५.६७.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa darbhaṁ saṁstarād gṛhya brahmāstreṇa hyayojayaḥ ।sa dīpta iva kālāgnirjajvālābhimukhaḥ khagam ।। 5.67.12 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You took out a blade of grass from your mat and chanted the mantra to invoke the weapon of Brahma (Brahmastra) and hurled it on the crow. It blazed like the fire of the doom's day.

verses.sloka: क्षिप्तवांस्त्वं प्रदीप्तं हि दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति ।ततस्तु वायसं दीप्तः स दर्भो ऽनुजगाम ह ।। ५.६७.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṣiptavāṁstvaṁ pradīptaṁ hi darbhaṁ taṁ vāyasaṁ prati ।tatastu vāyasaṁ dīptaḥ sa darbho 'nujagāma ha ।। 5.67.13 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You hurled the blazing blade of grass on to the crow. That burning blade of grass chased the crow.

verses.sloka: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः ।त्रिल्लोकान् संपरिक्रम्य त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति ।। ५.६७.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiśca samaharṣibhiḥ ।trillokān saṁparikramya trātāraṁ nādhigacchati ।। 5.67.14 ।।।।

translations.english: 'He was abandoned by his father, even by great sages and gods. Then he went round the three worlds but could not find a saviour.

verses.sloka: पुनरेवागतस्त्रस्तस्त्वकाशमरिन्दम ।स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् ।। ५.६७.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: punarevāgatastrastastvakāśamarindama ।sa taṁ nipatitaṁ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam ।। 5.67.15 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O destroyer of enemies the crow came back again to you trembling seeking protection from you and fell on the ground. Even though it deserved to be slayed, you saved him out of compassion.

verses.sloka: वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ कृपया पर्यपालयः ।। ५.६७.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vadhārhamapi kākutstha kṛpayā paryapālayaḥ ।। 5.67.16 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O Rama since a divine weapon cannot be withdrawn, it did strike his right eye'.

verses.sloka: मोघमस्त्रं न शक्यं तु कर्तुमित्येव राघव ।भवांस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम् ।। ५.६७.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: moghamastraṁ na śakyaṁ tu kartumityeva rāghava ।bhavāṁstasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam ।। 5.67.17 ।।।।

translations.english: The crow, once released, regained its own abode. "Thus, though you are the best among knowers of missiles, of great being and of good character too —

verses.sloka: राम त्वां स नमस्कृत्य राज्ञे दशरथाय च ।विसृष्टस्तु तदा काकः प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम् ।। ५.६७.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāma tvāṁ sa namaskṛtya rājñe daśarathāya ca ।visṛṣṭastu tadā kākaḥ pratipede svamālayam ।। 5.67.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "— for what reason, Raghava, do you not employ the missile against the rakshasas? Neither danavas nor gandharvas, neither asuras nor the hosts of Maruts —

verses.sloka: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्त्ववाञ्छीलवानपि ।किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयति राघवः ।। ५.६७.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamastravidāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ sattvavāñchīlavānapi ।kimarthamastraṁ rakṣassu na yojayati rāghavaḥ ।। 5.67.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "— are able so to contend with you in battle, Rama. If you the valorous have any concern for me —

verses.sloka: न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः ।न च सर्वे रणे शक्ता रामं प्रतिसमासितुम् ।। ५.६७.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ ।na ca sarve raṇe śaktā rāmaṁ pratisamāsitum ।। 5.67.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "— let Ravana be slain swiftly in battle with keen shafts; or let Lakshmana, scorcher of foes, receive his brother's command.

verses.sloka: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः ।क्षिप्रं सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्हन्यतां युधि रावणः ।। ५.६७.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya vīryavataḥ kaścidyadyasti mayi sambhramaḥ ।kṣipraṁ suniśitairbāṇairhanyatāṁ yudhi rāvaṇaḥ ।। 5.67.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "For what reason does that best of men, Raghava, not protect me? Those two tigers among men, of splendour equal to wind and fire, are able —

verses.sloka: भ्रातुरादेशमाज्ञाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः ।स किमर्थं नरवरो न मां रक्षति राघवः ।। ५.६७.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrāturādeśamājñāya lakṣmaṇo vā parantapaḥ ।sa kimarthaṁ naravaro na māṁ rakṣati rāghavaḥ ।। 5.67.22 ।।।।

translations.english: "— and unassailable even to the gods: for what reason do they overlook me? Surely some great misdeed of mine alone is the cause —

verses.sloka: शक्तौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ ।सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः ।। ५.६७.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śaktau tau puruṣavyāghrau vāyvagnisamatejasau ।surāṇāmapi durdharṣau kimarthaṁ māmupekṣataḥ ।। 5.67.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "— in that those two scorchers of foes, though able and together, do not protect me." Having heard the piteous and well-spoken word of Vaidehi,

verses.sloka: ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः ।समर्थो सहितौ यन्मां नावेक्षेते परन्तपौ ।। ५.६७.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mamaiva duṣkṛtaṁ kiṁcinmahadasti na saṁśayaḥ ।samartho sahitau yanmāṁ nāvekṣete parantapau ।। 5.67.24 ।।।।

translations.english: I spoke to her once again: "Lady, I swear to you by truth, Rama is turned away from all but grief for you.

verses.sloka: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् ।पुनरप्यहमार्यां तामिदं वचनमब्रुवम् ।। ५.६७.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vaidehyā vacanaṁ śrutvā karuṇaṁ sāśrubhāṣitam ।punarapyahamāryāṁ tāmidaṁ vacanamabruvam ।। 5.67.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "And when Rama is overcome with sorrow, Lakshmana burns with it. Your ladyship has been found at last; this is no time for grieving.

verses.sloka: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे ।रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ।। ५.६७.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena te śape ।rāme duḥkhābhibhūte tu lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate ।। 5.67.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "In this very moment, radiant lady, you shall see the end of your sorrows. Those two tigers among men, princes and scorchers of foes,

verses.sloka: कथंचिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम् ।इम मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि ।। ५.६७.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁcidbhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ pariśocitum ।ima muhūrtaṁ duḥkhānāmantaṁ drakṣyasi bhāmini ।। 5.67.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "their zeal roused by the sight of you, shall reduce Lanka to ashes; and having slain in battle the terrible Ravana with his kinsmen,

verses.sloka: तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ राजपुत्रावनिन्दितौ ।त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः ।। ५.६७.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāvubhau naraśārdūlau rājaputrāvaninditau ।tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhau laṅkāṁ bhasmīkariṣyataḥ ।। 5.67.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "Raghava shall assuredly lead you to his own city, fair one. And what token, blameless one, Rama would recognise,

verses.sloka: हत्वा च समरे रौद्र रावण सहबान्धवम् ।राघवस्त्वां वरारोहे स्वां पुरीं नयते ध्रुवम् ।। ५.६७.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatvā ca samare raudra rāvaṇa sahabāndhavam ।rāghavastvāṁ varārohe svāṁ purīṁ nayate dhruvam ।। 5.67.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "begetting joy in him, that you should give me." She looked round all the quarters, and from her garment

verses.sloka: यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते ।प्रीतिसञ्जननं तस्य प्रदातुं त्वमिहार्हसि ।। ५.६७.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yattu rāmo vijānīyādabhijñānamanindite ।prītisañjananaṁ tasya pradātuṁ tvamihārhasi ।। 5.67.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "loosed the excellent knot of her braid and gave me this gem, O you of great strength. Receiving the gem in both hands for your sake, beloved of the Raghus,

verses.sloka: सा ऽभिवीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वा वेण्युद्ग्रथनमुत्तमम् ।मुक्त्वा वस्त्राद्ददौ मह्यं मणिमेतं महाबल ।। ५.६७.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā 'bhivīkṣya diśaḥ sarvā veṇyudgrathanamuttamam ।muktvā vastrāddadau mahyaṁ maṇimetaṁ mahābala ।। 5.67.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "I saluted her with my head and made haste to return. Seeing my zeal made ready for the going, the lady of fair complexion,

verses.sloka: प्रतिगृह्य मणिं दिव्यं तव हेतो रघूद्वह ।शिरसा तां प्रणम्यार्यामहमागमने त्वरे ।। ५.६७.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhya maṇiṁ divyaṁ tava heto raghūdvaha ।śirasā tāṁ praṇamyāryāmahamāgamane tvare ।। 5.67.32 ।।।।

translations.english: "as I swelled in size, addressed me, the daughter of Janaka, her face full of tears, piteous, her speech choked with weeping.

verses.sloka: गमने च कृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य वरवर्णिनी ।विवर्धमानं च हि मामुवाच जनकात्मजा ।। ५.६७.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: gamane ca kṛtotsāhamavekṣya varavarṇinī ।vivardhamānaṁ ca hi māmuvāca janakātmajā ।। 5.67.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "Startled by my springing up and struck by the surge of grief, Sita then said to me: 'You are blessed, great monkey,

verses.sloka: अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पसन्दिग्धभाषिणी ।ममोत्पतनसम्भ्रान्ता शोकवेगसमाहता ।। ५.६७.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpasandigdhabhāṣiṇī ।mamotpatanasambhrāntā śokavegasamāhatā ।। 5.67.34 ।।।।

translations.english: "'in that you shall see the mighty-armed and lotus-eyed Rama, and the mighty-armed and illustrious Lakshmana, my brother-in-law.'

verses.sloka: हनुमन् सिंहसङ्काशावुभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।सुग्रीवं च सहामात्य सर्वान् ब्रूया ह्यनामयम् ।। ५.६७.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanuman siṁhasaṅkāśāvubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।sugrīvaṁ ca sahāmātya sarvān brūyā hyanāmayam ।। 5.67.35 ।।।।

translations.english: "Addressed thus by Sita, I spoke to Maithili: 'Lady, delight of Janaka, mount swiftly upon my back,

verses.sloka: यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः ।असमाद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ।। ५.६७.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathā ca sa mahābāhurmāṁ tārayati rāghavaḥ ।asamādduḥkhāmbusaṁrodhāttvaṁ samādhātumarhasi ।। 5.67.36 ।।।।

translations.english: "'that today I may show you your lord Raghava, greatly blessed and dark-eyed one, with Sugriva and with Lakshmana.'

verses.sloka: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च ।ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं शिवश्च ते ऽध्वा ऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर ।। ५.६७.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: imaṁ ca tīvraṁ mama śokavegaṁ rakṣobhirebhiḥ paribhartsanaṁ ca ।brūyāstu rāmasya gataḥ samīpaṁ śivaśca te 'dhvā 'stu haripravīra ।। 5.67.37 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then that lady said to me: 'Great monkey, bull among vanaras, that I should of my own will resort to your back — this is no dharma.

verses.sloka: एतत्तवार्या नृपराजसिंह सीता वचः प्राह विषादपूर्वम् ।एतच्च बुद्ध्वा गदितं मया त्वं श्रद्धत्स्व सीतां कुशलां समग्राम् ।। ५.६७.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: etattavāryā nṛparājasiṁha sītā vacaḥ prāha viṣādapūrvam ।etacca buddhvā gaditaṁ mayā tvaṁ śraddhatsva sītāṁ kuśalāṁ samagrām ।। 5.67.38 ।।

translations.english: "'And formerly, hero, I was touched upon the limbs by the rakshasa; what could I do therein, sore pressed by time?
